name: Zheng Shangyou
summary: Chinese climbing shedding card game where players try to empty their hand by beating the previous combination.
rules_text: Deal all cards from one 54-card deck (two decks for 4+ players). Rank is 3 low up to 2 high, jokers highest with red over black; suits optional. Valid plays are single, pair, consecutive pairs, trips, consecutive trips, trips+single, full house, 5+ straight, bomb (4+ of a kind) and joker bomb. The holder of the agreed trick card leads. Clockwise, each player must play a higher same-type combination or pass; passing does not block future turns. When all but one pass, the trick ends, cards are discarded, and the last player to play leads anew. Red joker single or pair of 2s is unbeatable except by bombs and may lead again immediately. First out is Winner, last with cards is Loser; Loser shuffles next and may give highest card to Winner for a return.
rating_reason: Climbing shedding game, hidden hands, race, fully turn-based strategic.
